_comment: Global wiring for the SEO stage gate, merged into ~/.claude/settings.json. The repository's .claude/settings.json only covers sessions opened inside this checkout; the skills are installed globally via ~/.claude/skills symlinks and are used from other projects, so the gate needs a global entry too. Deliberately does NOT cd: the hook resolves .seo-run/active.json relative to the working directory, so each project keeps its own run manifest. Guards exit 0 when the script or python3 is absent -- without them a missing path makes python3 exit 2, which is indistinguishable from a deny and blocks every Bash call in every project. Verify with: python3 runtime/check_hook_wiring.py

hooks.command: H="$HOME/code/SEO-Skills/runtime/stage_hook.py"; [ -f "$H" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$H" pre
H="$HOME/code/SEO-Skills/runtime/stage_hook.py"; [ -f "$H" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$H" stop
H="$HOME/code/SEO-Skills/runtime/stage_hook.py"; [ -f "$H" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec python3 "$H" stop
